title: ERC20 tokens that have a fee-on-transfer mechanism require special handling
summary: ## Proof of Concept  Some tokens take a transfer fee (`STA`, `PAXG`) and there are some that currently do not but might do so in the future (`USDT`, `USDC`). Since Zerem might be integrated with a protocol that works with all types of ERC20 tokens, and Zerem should too, this can lead to problems.  Let’s look at the following scenario:  1. Alice tries to claim tokens that have a fee-on-transfer mechanism from a protocol that is integrated with Zerem 2.
